{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blouse, relaxed fit with a slight drape at the neckline, color #e3c3a2, soft cotton blend.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight cut through the thigh tapering gently at the ankle, color #dcb995, durable woven twill.
Ankle boots, chunky heel, pointed toe, color #e9ccae, smooth leather.
This ensemble works because it adheres to her request for a smart and classic register while ensuring she can stand firmly in a dense crowd without feeling restricted. The wide-leg trousers and ankle boots provide stability and confidence on the dance floor or while walking through the venue, essential given her intention to move around a lot. By choosing neutral earth tones that match her natural complexion, the outfit remains elegant and timeless, allowing the energetic rock concert atmosphere to be the true focal point."}
